abilities.trace: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon’s Ability.
abilities.inner-focus: The Pokémon’s intensely focused, and that protects the Pokémon from flinching.
abilities.battle-armor: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
abilities.magma-armor: The Pokémon is covered with hot magma, which prevents the Pokémon from becoming frozen.
abilities.water-veil: The Pokémon is covered with a water veil, which prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.
abilities.magnet-pull: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from escaping using its magnetic force.
abilities.soundproof: Soundproofing of the Pokémon itself gives full immunity to all sound-based moves.
abilities.sand-stream: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.
abilities.pressure: By putting pressure on the opposing Pokémon, it raises their PP usage.
abilities.thick-fat: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.
abilities.early-bird: The Pokémon awakens twice as fast as other Pokémon from sleep.
abilities.sturdy: It cannot be knocked out with one hit. One-hit KO moves cannot knock it out, either.
abilities.keen-eye: Keen eyes prevent other Pokémon from lowering this Pokémon’s accuracy.
abilities.hyper-cutter: The Pokémon’s proud of its powerful pincers. They prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.
abilities.pickup: The Pokémon may pick up the item an opposing Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.
abilities.truant: The Pokémon can’t use a move the following turn if it uses one.
abilities.plus: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
abilities.minus: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
abilities.forecast: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.
abilities.damp: Prevents the use of explosive moves such as Self-Destruct by dampening its surroundings.
abilities.sticky-hold: Items held by the Pokémon are stuck fast and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.
abilities.shed-skin: The Pokémon may heal its own status conditions by shedding its skin.
abilities.guts: It’s so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat.
abilities.marvel-scale: The Pokémon’s marvelous scales boost the Defense stat if it has a status condition.
abilities.liquid-ooze: Oozed liquid has strong stench, which damages attackers using any draining move.
abilities.overgrow: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.
abilities.blaze: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.
abilities.torrent: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.
abilities.swarm: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.
abilities.limber: Its limber body protects the Pokémon from paralysis.
abilities.vital-spirit: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.
abilities.white-smoke: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.
abilities.pure-power: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.
abilities.shell-armor: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
abilities.motor-drive: Boosts its Speed stat if hit by an Electric-type move, instead of taking damage.
abilities.rivalry: Becomes competitive and deals more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but deals less to Pokémon of the opposite gender.
abilities.steadfast: The Pokémon’s determination boosts the Speed stat each time the Pokémon flinches.
abilities.gluttony: Makes the Pokémon eat a held Berry when its HP drops to half or less, which is sooner than usual.
abilities.anger-point: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.
abilities.unburden: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon’s held item is used or lost.
abilities.heatproof: The heatproof body of the Pokémon halves the damage from Fire-type moves that hit it.
abilities.simple: The stat changes the Pokémon receives are doubled.
abilities.dry-skin: Restores HP in rain or when hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in sunshine, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.
abilities.download: Compares an opposing Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever will be more effective.
abilities.static: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity, so contact with it may cause paralysis.
abilities.poison-heal: Restores HP if the Pokémon is poisoned, instead of losing HP.
abilities.skill-link: Maximizes the number of times multi-strike moves hit.
abilities.solar-power: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat in sunny weather, but HP decreases every turn.
abilities.normalize: All the Pokémon’s moves become Normal type. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
abilities.sniper: Powers up moves if they become critical hits when attacking.
abilities.no-guard: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.
